Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly recorded Luis César Amadori’s death year as 1997 instead of the correct 1977, despite WebSurfer having already surfaced the accurate 1977 date. The Planner also stated no reconfirmation was needed, cementing the error. This misdated year would invert the comparison against Raymond Rouleau (d. 1981) and lead to the wrong conclusion about which film’s director died later.
